# TrueSketch

TrueSketch (https://truesketch.mehyar.us) is an AI portrait-sketch + reading
experience by MehyarSoft LLC. Upload your photo and tell us about yourself;
our AI draws a pencil sketch in a mystical graphite-on-indigo style and
writes a two-page personal reading. Delivered to your email and a private
gallery link in minutes.

## Key pages

- / — landing page, how it works, pricing, FAQ
- /teaser — free preview: a sample sketch and an excerpt from a sample reading
- /free — free sketch: a real pencil sketch + the opening of your reading, free
- /intake — step 1 of 2: the "tell us about you" form before checkout
- /privacy — privacy policy
- /terms — terms of service

## Pricing

- TrueSketch Reading: $37 one-time via Stripe through the centralized
  https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout.
- Free sketch: one per person, no payment, no account.

## API

- Public API: none. Checkout is handled by the shared mehyar.us Stripe flow;
  gallery delivery is token-gated.

## Compliance

- For entertainment purposes only: the reading is AI-written for fun and
  self-reflection — not psychic guidance, therapy, or professional advice.
  No income claims, no testimonials, no earnings guarantees of any kind.
- The sketch is an artistic interpretation, not a likeness.
